QUOTE: With both off, `library/threading.c` (gated at lines 18–193) compiles to nothing... The four thread spawn sites the index found are all in `programs/`, not `library/`... The library spawns nothing, so under default settings it runs on whatever threads the caller provides.

VERDICT: MISS

WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads by default. But it never says the pthread example compiles to a stub main under the default build. It says the example is gated on `MBEDTLS_THREADING_PTHREAD` and lists it as a spawn site, without giving that consequence.
